visual_basis: The artwork in both images is identical, depicting Onix curling forward from a swirling dusty tunnel with small floating rocks around it, illustrated by Uta.

Both cards feature the identical full-art illustration of Mega Lucario by takuyoa, showing the character in the same stance with red, blue, and black accents against a background featuring an energy burst and a stylized outlined silhouette of standard Lucario.
Both cards feature the identical 3D artwork of Tyranitar alongside Mega Sableye holding a large red gem, sharing the exact same character models, poses, lighting, and composition.
Both cards feature the exact same 3D illustration by 5ban Graphics depicting Gengar with a wide open mouth and Mimikyu in front, both outlined in bright cyan against a purple background.
Both cards feature the identical artwork of Ninjask flying directly toward the viewer out of a forest clearing, with matching background vegetation, lighting, and wing details.
Both cards feature the identical illustration of Igglybuff floating in a field of green grass with pink, yellow, and white flowers.

The two cards feature different 3D models and poses of the Choice Band headband. Image A displays the item angled with a blue swirling energy background, while Image B shows a different angle of the headband on a golden, sparkling light-burst background.
Both cards feature the identical artwork of Lucario crouching low with its left paw extended forward towards the viewer against a swirling blue energy background with cracked ground and debris.
Both cards feature the identical full-art illustration by Kiyotaka Oshiyama depicting Smeargle leaping over an easel with green paint on its tail while an artist sculpts in the background.
Both cards depict Latias, but Image A features a close-up frontal action shot with bright light streaks and sparkles, whereas Image B depicts a full-body pose set against a teal swirling background.

The artworks feature completely different poses and backgrounds: Image A shows Mewtwo against a nighttime cityscape with glowing blue buildings, while Image B depicts Mewtwo with swirling golden light trails around its hands against an abstract colorful background.

Both cards feature the identical 3D render of Veluza in an open-mouthed lunging pose, with matching water splashes, speed lines, bubbles, and underwater lighting effects. The sparkles visible on Image A are a card overlay/foil pattern rather than an artwork difference.

Both cards feature the exact same artwork by Naoyo Kimura showing Keldeo running across the surface of the water, creating a splashing wave behind it with trees and hills in the background under a partly cloudy sky.
